description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build and ship polished web interfaces for a data-driven platform, working closely with research and operations colleagues. You will move quickly from idea to production, delivering features that many users rely on every day.
 What you'll do
 - Ship intuitive, well-crafted user interface features used daily by a large user base.
 - Build fast, responsive front ends on top of large-scale data processing systems.
 - Design interfaces that present machine learning and signal-processing capabilities to customers.
 - Work with researchers and operations colleagues to quickly deploy interfaces that support experimentation.
 - Keep up with current frontend tools and frameworks and apply them to improve the product.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2+ years of frontend software engineering experience.
 - Proficiency in TypeScript.
 - Experience building production user interfaces with React.
 - Familiarity with Node.js or PostgreSQL is helpful.
 - Experience delivering new product features end-to-end from zero to one.
 Bonus points
 - Experience at a high-growth startup.
 - Experience building data-heavy or machine-learning-driven interfaces at production scale.
 - Computer science degree.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 175,000 to 225,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Flexible time off
 - Retirement plan
 - Tax-advantaged health accounts
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
